## What's new
<!-- fro-bot-narration-v1 -->

### Features

Runs now have a useful entry in Langfuse’s Sessions view instead of showing “No messages” for the `action.main` trace. The root trace includes a structured summary of the trigger, outcome, duration, and phase timings, with severity and a status message when relevant. Sensitive text is scrubbed, oversized values are capped, and repository/ref details are omitted when they cannot be safely scrubbed. [#2350](https://github.com/fro-bot/agent/pull/2350)

### Bug fixes

Background jobs and subagents continue to report their results correctly on OpenCode 2.4. Its `<background-result>` notices are now recognized alongside the earlier `<subagent>` form, preventing missed runtime observations and interim reports being incorrectly marked completed. The bundled Fro Bot plugin update also includes this compatibility fix, avoids exporting a redacted Langfuse session ID, and raises the secret-matching limit to cover long runner tokens. [#2347](https://github.com/fro-bot/agent/pull/2347) [#2354](https://github.com/fro-bot/agent/pull/2354)

After an isolated run, the post step no longer implies the sandbox was unconfirmed when it was restored but no durable session save was recorded. It now reports that specific state accurately, while still declining to save or retry; other sandbox states retain the existing warning. [#2351](https://github.com/fro-bot/agent/pull/2351)

## What's new
<!-- fro-bot-narration-v1 -->

### Features

When tracing is enabled, you can now follow the Action’s work beyond model turns: traces cover its lifecycle phases, slow operations, and post step, with outcomes and decisions recorded along the way. Lifecycle traces share the conversation’s Langfuse session with turn traces, and each turn links back to its run; credentials and other registered secrets are scrubbed before export. Tracing-off runs remain unchanged. [#2336](https://github.com/fro-bot/agent/pull/2336)

### Bug fixes

WebSocket-enabled servers no longer leave non-WebSocket upgrade requests hanging or risk a process crash if the client resets the connection. The updated server responds with `400 Bad Request` and closes the socket when no application upgrade handler takes responsibility; it also attaches an error listener as soon as the socket reaches the upgrade listener. [#2331](https://github.com/fro-bot/agent/pull/2331)

Repo-skill setup now removes `GIT_COMMON_DIR` before running Git commands, preventing that variable from redirecting repository discovery. The root type-check command also includes `@fro-bot/workspace-agent`, bringing it in line with the root lint, fix, and test commands. [#2346](https://github.com/fro-bot/agent/pull/2346)

### Operational notes

The release-prep workflow documentation and test descriptions now clarify that its ref guard keeps scheduled and dispatched runs on the default branch, but is not a deployment-environment boundary: the job does not reference an environment that gates the App key. This corrects the stated security boundary without changing the guard itself. [#2342](https://github.com/fro-bot/agent/pull/2342)

## What's new
<!-- fro-bot-narration-v1 -->

Setting `skip-cache: 'true'` now skips both restoring and saving the session cache; previously, only the `SKIP_CACHE` environment variable did so. The save result is reported as `skipped`, and the post-action honors the input using a value recorded by the main action. The existing environment variable continues to work, and the input documentation now describes both behaviors. [#2326](https://github.com/fro-bot/agent/pull/2326)

The run-tracing documentation now records an end-to-end check of the published v0.147.0 action, including isolated and non-isolated runs, a wrong-credential run, and relay trace counts. It also clarifies that the pinned tracing plugin sends traces, correcting an outdated `trace-endpoint` description; one planned local continuation-trace check remains open. [#2323](https://github.com/fro-bot/agent/pull/2323)

## What's new
<!-- fro-bot-narration-v1 -->

Systematic’s project-connection research now flags when one checkout pins a dependency at a different version from another, making cross-project version drift easier to spot. It also reads user configuration from `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/opencode` when that variable is set, matching OpenCode’s configuration lookup behavior. [#2314](https://github.com/fro-bot/agent/pull/2314)

## What's new
<!-- fro-bot-narration-v1 -->

Run tracing is now available in the Action when you provide `trace-endpoint`; `trace-headers` can supply collector credentials. The Action forwards each turn's trace through a loopback relay, keeping the collector credential out of the agent server's environment, and tracing remains off when the endpoint is unset.

Tracing is best-effort: invalid settings produce a warning without exposing their values, and relay or collector failures do not fail the run. The documentation explains what trace data contains, how credentials are handled with and without `isolate-agent`, and the privacy implications of sending prompts and tool activity to your chosen collector. [#2285](https://github.com/fro-bot/agent/pull/2285), [#2292](https://github.com/fro-bot/agent/pull/2292), [#2315](https://github.com/fro-bot/agent/pull/2315)

Supplying provider credentials without choosing a model now makes the default explicit: the Action reports that it will use `opencode/big-pickle` and warns when supplied credentials will go unused. If configuration disables that model's provider, the run now fails at startup with the cause and remedy instead of failing on its first turn. [#2278](https://github.com/fro-bot/agent/pull/2278)

The repository now runs Systematic's `ce:connect` sweep daily, with manual dispatch also available. Its report issue, ledger cache, and run artifacts stay in this repository; configure the documented repository variables before the first run. [#2317](https://github.com/fro-bot/agent/pull/2317)

CI checks no longer rely on a short-circuiting `grep -q` pipeline to inspect logs or a tarball listing. Reading the output first and matching it without a pipe avoids broken-pipe errors under `pipefail`, including false reports that a required plugin notice file is missing. [#2304](https://github.com/fro-bot/agent/pull/2304), [#2312](https://github.com/fro-bot/agent/pull/2312)
